page: Vultr vbm-8c-132gb is a dedicated bare-metal server configured for memory-intensive and data-heavy applications. The platform is powered by an eight-core, sixteen-thread Intel Xeon E-2288G processor operating at a base clock of 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Compute resources are strictly dedicated without hypervisor overhead, supported by 16 MB of L3 cache and hardware support for AVX, AES-NI, and FMA vector extensions. The instance is provisioned with 128 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, establishing a generous 8 GB per logical core allocation.

Storage is bundled directly into the bare-metal chassis through a 3840 GB NVMe SSD array, delivering direct low-latency disk access for input-output demanding operations. Network connectivity is supported by one complimentary public IPv4 address. The server does not contain hardware GPU accelerators, directing all processing capacity toward CPU and memory operations.

Performance profiles show strong single-threaded data compression and decompression execution, highlighted by gzip single-thread throughput of 36.22 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 14.23 GB/sec. Synthetic memory assessments place its PassMark memory score in the top ten percent at 3594.89, although uncached large-block read (29.76 GB/sec) and write (15.32 GB/sec) bandwidth metrics trail modern multi-channel server architectures. Compute throughput remains dependable, generating 19837.37 points in multi-core stress-ng tests and handling 17.28 million Redis SET operations per second.

Cost efficiency is grounded in its high RAM density, dedicated hardware access, and integrated high-capacity NVMe disk without per-gigabyte cloud storage attachment fees. The absence of virtualization layers eliminates noisy-neighbor variance. The server is well suited for transactional relational databases, Redis or Memcached in-memory caching tiers, large ETL processing pipelines, and sustained application serving environments requiring dependable memory density and fast local scratch storage.
description: Vultr vbm-8c-132gb is a dedicated bare-metal server built on an 8-core, 16-thread Intel Xeon E-2288G processor clocked at 3.7 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture with dedicated hardware resources, it features 128 GB of DDR4 memory clocked at 3 GHz, providing an 8:1 memory-to-thread ratio. Storage is bundled with 3840 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity, alongside one complimentary public IPv4 address and no GPU accelerators. In benchmarks, the server demonstrates top-tier PassMark memory performance and strong single-threaded compression throughput, alongside solid caching performance of 17.28 million Redis SET operations per second. However, large-block uncached memory bandwidth represents a potential bottleneck under memory-streaming workloads. Delivering cost-effective memory and NVMe capacity without hypervisor overhead, the vbm-8c-132gb is appropriate for relational databases, in-memory key-value caching layers, data processing, and enterprise application hosting.
